title: DMT-Attack: Diffusion-Prior Texture Search for Closed-Loop Vision-Language-Action Policies
abstract: arXiv:2611.25695v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies rely on visual feedback throughout manipulation, making them vulnerable to persistent texture attacks. However, optimized patterns can stand out from their surroundings, making an attack easier to notice and its carrier more likely to be inspected or removed. To address this limitation, our key insight is to search the structured image distribution of a diffusion model for natural-looking textures while using closed-loop feedback to identify task-disruptive candidates. Based on this idea, we propose DMT-Attack, a gradient-free gray-box attack that generates textures for ordinary scene objects such as tablecloths. A frozen text-conditioned diffusion model defines the search space, and an eight-expert latent proposal network is initialized from evaluated teacher latents and refined using rollout feedback. We evaluate DMT-Attack against pi_0.5 and OpenVLA-OFT across four LIBERO suites. DMT-Attack achiev

translated_title: DMT-Attack：面向闭环视觉-语言-动作策略的扩散先验纹理搜索
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略在整个操作过程中依赖视觉反馈，这使其容易受到持续性纹理攻击。然而，优化出的图案往往会与周围环境格格不入，使攻击更容易被察觉，其载体也更容易被检查或移除。针对这一局限，我们的关键洞察是：在扩散模型的结构化图像分布中搜索外观自然的纹理，同时利用闭环反馈来识别具有任务破坏性的候选纹理。基于这一思路，我们提出了DMT-Attack，这是一种无梯度的灰盒攻击方法，能够为桌布等普通场景物体生成纹理。该方法使用一个冻结的文本条件扩散模型定义搜索空间，并采用一个由八位专家组成的潜变量提案网络，该网络从经过评估的教师潜变量初始化，并通过闭环滚动反馈进行优化。我们在四个LIBERO测试套件上针对pi_0.5和OpenVLA-OFT评估了DMT-Attack。DMT-Attack实现了（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出DMT-Attack，一种无梯度灰盒攻击方法，通过在冻结扩散模型的图像分布中搜索自然外观的纹理，并利用闭环滚动反馈优化八专家潜变量提案网络，从而对视觉-语言-动作策略实施隐蔽且有效的持续性纹理攻击。
en_tdlr: DMT-Attack is a gradient-free gray-box attack that leverages a frozen diffusion model's image distribution prior to search for natural-looking textures and refines an eight-expert latent proposal network via closed-loop rollout feedback to stealthily disrupt vision-language-action policies.
